left: The product is named THE Hybrid System.
right: Many archived artifacts call it Hybrid Engine.
analysis_or_resolution: Resolve only in new platform material; preserve source filenames and quoted titles unchanged.

left: Some documents label their material validated, final, or high confidence.
right: No independent corpus-wide source verification or schema validation accompanied those labels.
analysis_or_resolution: Treat labels as document assertions, not review results.

left: Inherited +2.5% progression and -5% reduction are described as project defaults.
right: The strength claim matrix explicitly says they are project facts, not science.
analysis_or_resolution: Keep as inactive policy candidates until owned, tested, and validated.

left: A single readiness score is attractive for coordination.
right: Corpus safety claims say pain, illness, missingness, fatigue and performance must not collapse into one override scalar.
analysis_or_resolution: Use a vector state plus hard-constraint precedence; optional score cannot clear safety states.

left: Fixed readiness threshold can block heavy lifting.
right: Cross-system claim CR-018 rejects a universal threshold as unsupported.
analysis_or_resolution: No universal threshold in executable rules.

right: Cross-system claim CR-017 rejects this as a validated universal rule.
analysis_or_resolution: Treat missed sessions as context only.

left: 7700 kcal/kg can provide transparent target arithmetic.
right: Nutrition registry labels symmetric 7700 conversion as HYBRID_INFERENCE/prototype rather than validated physiology for all contexts.
analysis_or_resolution: Retain only as an explicitly versioned approximation; not active clinical logic.

left: ACWR can be represented from acute/chronic load.
right: Strength claim S-043 says universal ACWR injury-risk thresholds are unreliable.
analysis_or_resolution: Retain contextual histories; do not create a danger threshold.

left: Product pages document observable competitor behavior.
right: They do not scientifically validate THE Hybrid System or reveal private coefficients.

left: Exact duplicate files appear in different system folders and historical packs.
right: Path context differs even when bytes are identical.
analysis_or_resolution: Use one canonical content hash while preserving every occurrence.

left: Nutrition formula registry documents an update gate of at least 4 valid nutrition days and 1 valid weight day in 7.
right: The archived adaptive_engine.py applies a 6-of-7 adherence condition across two weeks for a different adjustment path.
analysis_or_resolution: Do not merge these into one rule; specify purpose, horizon and evidence before implementation.

left: Nutrition protein targets are expressed on a fat-free-mass basis in the formula registry.
right: Other nutrition material and prototype code use body-mass bases in places.
analysis_or_resolution: Require explicit metric basis and population policy; no silent conversion.

left: The archived governance decision-receipt schema requires an `engine` property.
right: Its defined properties use `system`, so conforming instances cannot satisfy the required field under additionalProperties=false.
analysis_or_resolution: New canonical schema uses explicit model/system lineage; archived schema remains preserved and flagged invalid for adoption.

left: The target architecture has five domain systems feeding control.
right: Existing cross-system proposal contracts cover Strength and Conditioning but not complete Nutrition, Recovery and Coordinator proposal payloads.
analysis_or_resolution: Treat current contracts as partial and use the new five-system interface design as a schema-design starting point only.

left: Archived Coach Brain material proposes LLM-style runtime coaching behavior.
right: The governing requirement restricts LLMs to untrusted offline assistance and requires deterministic non-LLM runtime decisions.
analysis_or_resolution: Exclude LLM Coach Brain behavior from runtime model registry and executable rules.
